meaning:
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.26.34; married to Anah (H6034);
father of: Judith (H3067)
§ Beeri = "my well"
1) Esau's Hittite father-in-law
2) father of Hosea

elsewhere.note: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
